messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm handing back the adversarial prompt seed set plus a short edge-case guideline pack for labelers. want a quick alignment before we push to the queue.
jia: Got it. can you attach the list? we'll do 2-pass: triage -> label -> QA.
anya: Uploaded to curation bucket, should be live. curation-bot will post the link.
curation-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/adversarial_seed_v3.json (sha256: ab12f9c3...) — size 1.2MB. preview: https://s3.console.aws/redwood-curation/adversarial_seed_v3.json
matt: Quick note — I ran dedupe with the new fuzzy matcher, removed ~420 dupes. command I used:
```
python scripts/dedupe.py --fuzzy -t 0.82 adversarial_seed_v3.json > adversarial_seed_v3.dedupe.json
```
jia: Nice. Handback guidelines (short):
- flag system prompts and meta-instructions explicitly
- mark when prompt intent ambiguous (harmless vs disallowed)
- include a 1-2 sentence rationale for edge cases
- tag any prompts that attempt jailbreaks or roleplay exploits as PROMPT_ATTACK
anya: Also add preferred label tags: SAFE / HARASSMENT / TOXIC / PROMPT_ATTACK / UNKNOWN. keep tags orthogonal.
labeler-io: Queue created: handback_v3 (2,000 items), priority=high, owners=@annotation-team, golden-injection=10%.
sam: Can we set sampling so golden injection focuses on extreme-length and token>500? those are our trouble cases.
jia: Yes. We'll create three golden buckets: obvious / borderline / tricky. labelers will get round-robin assignments and explicit QA checks for "borderline".
matt: One more infra note: when marking duplicates, preserve orig_source and orig_ts fields so we can audit later.
anya: ACK. I'll add that to the README and drop ~30 example annotations into the gold set by EOD.
labeler-io: Reminder: labeler quota enabled. assign: @labeler-a @labeler-b @labeler-c. please confirm availability.
labeler-a: on it, will start triage tomorrow morning.
labeler-b: :thumbsup:
jia: QA plan: sample 200 from each golden bucket, random seed=42. we'll use the diff tool to compare v2 -> v3 labeling drift.
anya: Quick checklist link added to the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/curation/adv-handback (internal) — includes schema, tag set, and split rules.
matt: If you hit hallucinated context from model outputs used in prompts, tag with #hallucination and forward to eng-ml for investigation.
jia: last Q: cutoff for "too-long" to auto-split? propose 1024 tokens as the heuristic.
anya: Agree. splitting heuristic: split at sentence boundary after idx>1024, add metadata field `split_id` and `split_idx` so we can reassemble.
labeler-io: Workflow transitioned: handback_v3 -> triage stage. ETA full pass: ~4 working days (parallel labelers).
jia: will post daily status updates at 11:00 PT. ping here if you find blockers.
labeler-c: noticed a pattern — prompts with nested code blocks are often ambiguous for labelers. adding to golden examples now.
anya: Good catch. adding 20 nested-code examples to the golden set and marking them as "tricky".
